attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: No explicit carrier H_N is yet supplied with both a target-clean polylog nonblackbox compact consumer and an i.o. N^{1+epsilon} general-circuit lower bound. The lower-bound proof also must be non-natural or otherwise outside the natural-proofs obstruction.
steps: Fix a target exponent c and assume, for contradiction, that SAT_m has circuits D_m of size m^c for all sufficiently large m.
For each sufficiently large valid carrier length N, set m=L(N)=floor((log N)^d), so the assumed SAT family supplies D_m.
Run the compact nonblackbox consumer T_N with D_m wired into its universal evaluator; no SAT truth table and no independent advice are allowed.
Because m^c=(log N)^{dc}=N^{o(1)}, the produced H_N circuit has size N^rho poly(m^c,m,log N)=N^{rho+o(1)}.
Choose delta>0 with rho+delta<1+epsilon. For large valid N, the upper bound is at most N^{rho+delta}, contradicting SIZE(H_N)>N^{1+epsilon} on infinitely many valid lengths.
Since c was arbitrary and rho does not depend on c, the conditional bridge excludes every fixed polynomial exponent for SAT circuits.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a valid conditional route lemma, not P != NP. It sharpens the surviving parameter window and names the falsifier tests, but it does not construct the carrier or prove the source lower bound.

branch_outputs.branch_title: Hardness-Magnification Bridge Realization: Polylog Nonblackbox Compact Consumer

assumptions: d>1 is a fixed constant independent of N and of the target exponent c.
For each fixed c, the universal-evaluation tax for a SAT circuit of size m^c is poly(m^c,m,log N)=N^{o(1)}.
The compact consumer exponent rho is independent of c; otherwise the all-exponent P/poly conclusion is invalid.
The source lower bound holds for infinitely many valid N after the target circuit family would already exist.
SAT is the standard NP-complete language under length-respecting encodings.
definitions: source object: A uniform carrier H={H_N} with H_N:{0,1}^N -> {0,1}, measured in nonuniform general circuit SIZE at source threshold N^{1+epsilon} on infinitely many valid N.
target object: SAT_m under nonuniform circuits of size m^c for each fixed c; excluding all fixed c gives SAT notin P/poly and hence NP not subset P/poly.
controlled interface: A nonblackbox compact consumer T_N that, from the description of a SAT_{L(N)} circuit D_m, constructs a circuit for H_N by universal evaluation of D_m, not by SAT-answer lookup.

target-preserving condition: H_N is defined independently of D_m, L(N)=floor((log N)^d) is unbounded along valid N, and all extra constants in T_N are uniform or derived from D_m so no nonuniform leakage enters.
valid length convention: If SAT has polynomial-size circuits for all large m, then it supplies D_{L(N)} for all large valid N; an i.o. source lower bound is enough for contradiction.
source model convention: The upper circuit produced by T_N must be counted in the same general SIZE model as the lower bound.

equations.label: fixed exponent amortization
equations.valid_when: Valid when c and d are constants, not growing with N.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: A decisive falsifier is any construction where rho>=1+epsilon, the consumer secretly uses SAT truth-table lookup, or nonuniform advice not implied by the SAT circuit is needed.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Positive route-level bridge with an exact threshold: the barely-superlinear lower bound magnifies only if rho<1+epsilon and the consumer is genuinely nonblackbox and target-clean.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Fix d>1, epsilon>0, and a compact-consumer exponent rho<1+epsilon. If a uniform carrier H_N has an i.o. general-circuit lower bound SIZE(H_N)>N^{1+epsilon} on valid lengths and every SAT circuit of size m^c at m=floor((log N)^d) yields a target-clean nonblackbox circuit for H_N of size N^rho poly(m^c,m,log N), then SAT is not in SIZE(n^c) for every fixed c. Hence SAT notin P/poly, conditional on the carrier and source lower bound.

assumptions: The lookup table is charged as ordinary nonuniform circuit constants or gates.
The consumer would need direct access to SAT answers for all L(N)-bit formulas if it is black-box.
The target-circuit substitution uses a circuit description D_m rather than the full truth table.
definitions: lookup object: A hardwired truth table for SAT on all formulas of length L(N).
boundary parameter: d in L(N)=(log N)^d separates logarithmic lookup from superlogarithmic compact substitution.
route use: Certifies why the cycle-12 window d>1 is not killed by the previous O(log N)-query falsifier.

candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Barrier-localization lemma: it distinguishes a valid polylog nonblackbox window from the quarantined logarithmic lookup route.
candidate_lemmas.statement: The old short-query lookup falsifier disappears only above logarithmic query length. For L(N)=(log N)^d with d>1, brute-force SAT_{L(N)} truth tables cost superpolynomial size in N, while hypothesized polynomial-size SAT circuits still cost N^{o(1)} after substitution.

assumptions: The source lower bound is against ordinary nonuniform circuits, so extra constants count as gates or wires.
The target assumption supplies only SAT circuits of size m^c, not arbitrary strings correlated with H_N.
Uniform glue may depend on N,d,rho and the fixed carrier definition.
definitions: leakage object: Auxiliary strings A_N, witness tables, lexicographically first circuit certificates, or verifier transcripts not computable from D_m and N.

barrier status: The upper bridge is nonrelativizing because it inspects circuit descriptions, but the source lower-bound proof must still avoid natural-proofs style density and constructivity.

candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Necessary certificate lemma for preserving the target consequence SAT notin P/poly rather than proving a separation against an augmented advice model.
candidate_lemmas.statement: A compact consumer is target-preserving only if every nonuniform object used in the H_N upper circuit is either the hypothesized SAT_{L(N)} circuit D_m or uniformly generated glue. Extra advice A_N makes the implication prove only SAT circuits plus A_N imply small H_N, which is not a valid P/poly separation route.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot or quarantine if every candidate carrier either becomes SAT(G(x)) black-box projection, needs L=O(log N), uses non-target advice, or has rho>=1+epsilon.

dependency_updates.description: Specialized from slogan to the polylog compact-consumer lemma: L=(log N)^d with d>1, source threshold N^{1+epsilon}, target SAT circuits m^c, and required overhead rho<1+epsilon.
Now fixed to general nonuniform SIZE for H_N:{0,1}^N->{0,1}; restricted-model lower bounds would only yield restricted target separations unless a separate lift is proved.
Target is SAT notin P/poly via exclusion of every fixed exponent c; the conclusion is valid only because L(N) is unbounded and SAT in P/poly would supply circuits on all corresponding lengths.
Need an explicit carrier and transformer using SAT circuit descriptions with exponent rho<1+epsilon and no independent advice.
The logarithmic truth-table falsifier is avoided only for d>1; it remains decisive for d<=1 or any carrier that can replace D_m by direct SAT answers.

The bridge's upper half is nonrelativizing, but a dense constructive proof of the general SIZE lower bound for H_N would still be natural and therefore suspect under standard pseudorandomness assumptions.

falsifier: L(N)=O(log N), because hardwired SAT truth tables give an unconditional lookup simulation.
falsifier: the carrier reduces to a black-box projection SAT(G(x)) in the same model, reviving the demagnification from earlier cycles.

falsifier: the produced upper circuit is not in the same SIZE model as the claimed source lower bound.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: For d<=1, lookup tables can be hardwired and should kill the source lower bound if the audit is black-box. For d>1, lookup becomes superpolynomial while D_m substitution remains N^{o(1)}, so any remaining failure should be visible as rho collapse, projection demagnification, or advice leakage.
held_fixed_controls: Source model is nonuniform general SIZE and the source threshold remains N^{1+epsilon}.
Target assumption supplies only SAT circuits of size m^c for fixed c, with no extra advice.
Consumer overhead excluding D_m is constrained to N^rho with rho<1+epsilon.
The carrier must be independent of the selected SAT circuit and valid on infinitely many N.
gedanken_experiment_design.need_decision: Design now as a falsifier probe and threshold calculator.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The branch has a valid d>1 window, but another abstract magnification restatement would not test target preservation. A concrete polylog audit carrier exposes the exact rho, lookup, and advice-leakage failure modes.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: PolyLogAudit_{N,d,V}: imagine a fixed verifier V whose N-bit input selects one local audit location in a canonical computation that uses a length-m SAT circuit description D_m, with m=floor((log N)^d). Under the target assumption D_m is wired into a universal evaluator; the Boolean carrier H_N is fixed by V and the canonical audit rule, not by the chosen D_m.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A formal construction of H_N and T_N proving SIZE(T_N[D_m])<=N^rho poly(|D_m|,m,log N), uniform derivation of all auxiliary data from D_m, and a source lower-bound method that is not a dense constructive natural proof.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 13 turns the superlogarithmic polylog window into an exact bridge: L=(log N)^d with d>1 makes SAT circuits of size L^c amortize to N^{o(1)}, while truth-table lookup costs 2^L=N^{omega(1)} and no longer supplies the old falsifier. The valid threshold is rho<1+epsilon for a target-clean nonblackbox compact consumer. The new hard obstruction is not folklore but the absence of an explicit carrier with no advice leakage and a non-natural N^{1+epsilon} general-circuit lower bound.
branch_outputs.next_experiment: Instantiate PolyLogAudit_{N,d,V} with a universal-circuit verifier, compute the exact overhead exponent rho and auxiliary advice length, and reject the instance immediately if H_N depends on a hidden SAT circuit or collapses to a black-box SAT query family.

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The derivation excludes only deterministic black-box local separators with hardwirable advice. It does not touch nonlocal algebraic, proof-theoretic, or syntax-sensitive methods that fail to contain a large accepting cylinder.
steps: Fix m and N=2^m. Let y=tt(SAT_m) and run the deterministic verifier V_m(alpha_m,y).
Record the adaptive accepting transcript: queried indices i_1,...,i_t with t<=q(N) and answers y_{i_j}.
Every z agreeing with y on those queried indices follows the same deterministic path and is accepted, so P_m contains a subcube of codimension at most q(N).
Therefore mu(P_m)>=2^{-q(N)}; when q<=a log N this is inverse-polynomial largeness.
Soundness gives P_m no truth table computable by circuits of size m^k, so P_m is useful against SIZE(m^k).
Hardwire alpha_m and the verifier into a full-truth-table decider. If its size is N^{O(1)}, this is a constructive or P/poly-natural property at the audited scale.

If a PRF family has every keyed function in SIZE(m^k), the property rejects all PRF truth tables but accepts a random truth table with probability at least 2^{-q}; this is a full-truth-table distinguisher.
Thus a low-query advised black-box lower-bound route is not a valid barrier escape unless it raises q, destroys hardwired constructivity, or uses a genuinely nonblack-box feature.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is route-level barrier control, not evidence for P != NP. It conditionally quarantines one proof-object type under the natural-proof/PRF audit and leaves the main lower bound unproved.

branch_outputs.branch_title: Barrier-Aware Lower-Bound Route: advised local naturalization gate

assumptions: V_m is deterministic after alpha_m is fixed.
V_m accepts the SAT_m truth table.
For every Boolean function g:{0,1}^m->{0,1} computable by circuits of size at most m^k, V_m(alpha_m,tt(g))=0.
The property decider obtained by hardwiring alpha_m has circuit size D(N).
The natural-proof audit is invoked only against full-truth-table distinguishers at size at least D(N) and advantage at least 2^{-q(N)}.
definitions: source object: a deterministic oracle verifier V_m(alpha, z) with advice alpha_m of length b(N), truth-table oracle z in {0,1}^N, N=2^m, and at most q(N) adaptive bit queries; it accepts the SAT_m truth table.
target object: the induced property P_m={z: V_m(alpha_m,z)=1}, intended to be useful against m^k-size Boolean circuits and therefore to certify only SAT notin SIZE(m^k), not P != NP.
controlled interface: hardwire alpha_m into the property decider, expose the accepting query transcript on SAT_m, and audit density, constructivity, and usefulness before claiming a barrier escape.

target-preserving condition: alpha_m and V_m must yield a valid property decider within the audited adversary scale, soundness must reject every m^k-size truth table, and the verifier may not add promises, oracle gates, or advice leakage that changes the target class.

equations.label: accepting_cylinder_density
equations.valid_when: Valid when V_m is deterministic and one accepting SAT transcript fixes at most q queried truth-table positions.

equations.label: hardwired_property_size
equations.valid_when: Applies when the advice string is hardwired and oracle queries are implemented as input-wire selections.

equations.label: polynomial_largeness_threshold
equations.valid_when: Valid when the density lower bound comes from a single accepting cylinder in the full truth-table cube.

equations.label: usefulness_condition
equations.valid_when: Requires soundness against every small circuit truth table, not merely against a sampled or promised subclass.

equations.label: full_truth_table_prf_distinguishing
equations.valid_when: Valid when every keyed function F_K has circuit size at most m^k and P_m is useful against that size.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If q=O(log N) and D(N)=N^{O(1)}, the route is a valid natural property and is blocked by the corresponding PRF/natural-proof hypothesis; if q is larger or D is superpolynomial, the route must supply a separate target-preserving escape lemma.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Turns a claimed low-query SAT lower-bound certificate into a large constructive useful property, giving a concrete natural-proof obstruction with advice accounting.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Any deterministic advised q-query black-box separator for the SAT_m truth table naturalizes unless its query bound, advice/decider size, or nonblack-box interface escapes the named quantitative thresholds.

assumptions: The source proof object remains black-box in the candidate truth table after advice is fixed.
The target lower bound is nonuniform SAT notin SIZE(m^k).
The proof claims barrier avoidance only through hidden alpha_m.
definitions: advice leakage: dependence of the lower-bound certificate on alpha_m not computable from 1^m inside the stated resource bound.
hardwired natural property: a P/poly decider for P_m on N-bit truth tables obtained by embedding alpha_m.
escape threshold: D(N)>N^c for every audited c, or q(N)=omega(log N), or a nonblack-box predicate that destroys the accepting-cylinder argument.

equations.label: advice_is_counted_in_decider
equations.valid_when: Applies when the property decider may be nonuniform and alpha_m is simply hardwired into its circuit description.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: A falsifier is any proposed separator whose only escape feature is an alpha_m of polynomial length; hardwiring alpha_m restores the natural-proof audit.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Prevents an invalid promotion where nonuniform advice is advertised as non-natural while still producing a small full-truth-table property tester.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Secret advice is not by itself a barrier escape: if the advice can be hardwired into polynomial-size full-truth-table deciders, the natural-proof obstruction still applies; if it cannot, the route loses constructive transfer unless a compression or uniformity certificate is proved.

assumptions: Completeness and soundness errors are two-sided before seed fixing.
Usefulness must hold simultaneously for all circuits of size s=m^k.
Amplification multiplies query complexity by the number of independent repetitions.
definitions: randomized source object: V_m(alpha,r,z) using rho random bits and q oracle queries.
all-circuit seed preservation: a fixed seed or small seed set accepts SAT_m and rejects every m^k-size truth table.
circuit count: the number of m-input circuits of size s is at most 2^{O(s log s)}.

equations.label: seed_union_bound_requirement
equations.valid_when: Valid when one wants a single deterministic seed choice to avoid failure on every size-s circuit.

equations.label: amplified_query_cost
equations.valid_when: Applies after independent amplification reduces two-sided error below the all-circuit union-bound threshold.

equations.label: randomized_polynomial_density_gate
equations.valid_when: Requires the amplified deterministic transcript to retain inverse-polynomial density in the N-bit truth-table universe.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: A q=1 randomized Hamming-ball style separator remains a falsifier to automatic naturalization unless the route proves all-circuit seed preservation.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Separates deterministic advised local naturalization from randomized protocols, naming the exact all-circuit soundness cost.
candidate_lemmas.statement: A randomized advised local separator naturalizes only after a seed-fixing step that preserves all-circuit soundness; otherwise the density lower bound is not valid.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot if the next proposed lower-bound object is nonlocal or syntax-sensitive enough that the accepting-cylinder argument no longer applies.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote only if the route supplies a nonblack-box transfer certificate, an advice-compression lemma, or a quantitative parameter choice outside q=O(log N) and D=N^{O(1)}.
control_decision.reason: The branch made a contribution-making move: it formalized a bridge from advised local truth-table separators to natural properties with explicit q, b, D, and density thresholds.

dependency_updates.description: Extended the local-query naturalization gate to advised deterministic separators: q controls largeness, while advice contributes to hardwired constructivity.
A route using hidden alpha_m must count alpha_m in the property decider or prove a target-preserving compression/uniformity lemma.
The audited source object is black-box in truth-table bits and therefore gives no nonrelativizing feature by itself.
No low-degree extension or algebraic oracle interface is used in this cycle; the obstruction is naturalness plus advice accounting.

falsifiers: A proposed q=O(log N) SAT separator with polynomial-size hidden advice is a falsifier for the claim that advice alone avoids natural proofs, because the advice can be hardwired.
A verifier whose soundness rejects only sampled circuits, average-case circuits, or a promise subset is a falsifier for target preservation: usefulness against SIZE(m^k) is then not valid.
A superpolynomial-advice separator may evade this naturalization lemma, but it is a falsifier for uniform-route claims unless an advice-compression bridge is supplied.
A randomized local separator without all-circuit seed preservation is a falsifier for deterministic-cylinder density claims.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: For every fixed gamma giving polynomial hardwired decider size, the accepting transcript yields density N^{-c} and the route becomes a natural property useful against SIZE(m^k). Only when gamma or verifier size makes the decider superpolynomial, or when the interface becomes nonblack-box, does the natural-proof audit stop applying; then target preservation must be re-certified.
held_fixed_controls: The verifier is deterministic and black-box in the candidate truth table after advice is fixed.
The target lower bound remains SAT_m notin SIZE(m^k), not P != NP.
Soundness is universal over all m^k-size circuits.
The property is evaluated on the full N-bit truth table, so density is measured in {0,1}^N.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The branch needs a concrete advice-leakage threshold, not another statement that natural proofs are a barrier. The experiment tests when a local SAT separator remains target-preserving after advice is hardwired.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: For each input length m, imagine an advised deterministic q-query verifier for the N=2^m-bit truth table of SAT_m. It accepts tt(SAT_m), rejects every truth table of an m-input circuit of size m^k, and uses an advice string alpha_m whose origin is deliberately unspecified.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A formal certificate showing either advice compression to a uniform/poly(N) decider with a non-natural feature, or a proof that the large-cylinder density argument is invalid because the verifier uses syntax, proof soundness, or another nonblack-box relation not reducible to queried truth-table bits.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: Advice length exponent gamma in b(N)=N^gamma, with q(N)=c log N held initially at the local-query threshold.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 13 isolates an advice-sensitive local naturalization lemma. Deterministic q-query SAT separators with hardwirable advice contain an accepting cylinder of density 2^{-q}; if q=O(log N) and the hardwired decider is polynomial in N, the object is a valid natural property useful against SIZE(m^k). Secret polynomial advice is therefore not a barrier escape. Superpolynomial advice may avoid the natural-proof falsifier but then loses constructive target transfer unless separately certified.
branch_outputs.next_experiment: Test a syntax-gated Cook-Levin/proof-system certificate that queries clauses or derivations rather than raw truth-table bits, and compute whether the accepting-cylinder density argument still survives under a target-preserving reduction to SAT_m notin SIZE(m^k).

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The argument does not exclude compressed non-enumerative soundness certificates, such as a genuinely non-natural proof-complexity object that refutes all small circuits simultaneously.
steps: Set N=2^m and assume a diagonal source verifier emits T and proves C(T)>s by excluding each m-input circuit of size at most s.
Use the standard encoding bound that the number of such circuits is 2^{Theta(s log s)}.
Since exhaustive certificate search over 2^{O(m)} certificates plus verification must remain in E, require verifier time 2^{O(m)}.
Thus the enumerative proof can be target-preserving only when 2^{Theta(s log s)}<=2^{O(m)}, equivalently s log s=O(m).
Solving gives s=O(m/log m), so epsilon_m=(log s)/m=O((log m)/m).
Plugging epsilon_m into the prior valid carrier bridge gives only delta<epsilon_m/kappa=o(1), not a constant exponential E lower bound.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a route-level quarantine of one source model, not a proof of P != NP or an impossibility theorem for all MCSP certificate sources.

assumptions: Circuit descriptions over fan-in two Boolean gates have count at most 2^{b s log s} and at least 2^{b' s log s} for standard encodings up to constant factors.

The source verifier is in the diagonal-enumeration model: its soundness argument inspects or excludes circuits separately, with no compressed algebraic or proof-complexity certificate for the whole low-circuit set.
The extraction theorem from prior cycles remains valid for kappa-dense source lengths and threshold s(m)=2^{epsilon m}.
definitions: source object: an O(m)-bit certificate c and a 2^{alpha m}-time sequential verifier V_m(c) that emits a truth table T_c in {0,1}^{2^m} and proves T_c is outside SIZE(s(m)) by enumerating or individually excluding all circuits of size at most s(m).
target object: an E language L whose length-m truth table equals some accepted T_c on kappa-dense source lengths, intended to satisfy C_L(n)>2^{delta n} for constant delta>0.

controlled interface: exhaustive search over O(m)-bit certificates followed by V_m must stay within 2^{O(m)} time, and the MCSP no-side threshold s(m) must transfer through the existing delta<epsilon/kappa extraction with epsilon=(log s(m))/m.

target-preserving condition: certificate length, verifier time, and source-length density are uniform constants, and no nonuniform selector, random-access generator, or advice string may identify hard tables outside the verifier.

equations.label: low_circuit_count
equations.valid_when: Valid when the source lower-bound model is explicitly Boolean fan-in two circuits with a fixed syntactic encoding and s is at least linear in m.

equations.label: enumeration_budget
equations.valid_when: Applies when the verifier certifies high MCSP by circuit-by-circuit exclusion and the E extraction budget fixes verification time to 2^{O(m)}.

equations.label: constant_threshold_failure
equations.valid_when: Valid when epsilon is a positive constant and the soundness source performs explicit diagonal enumeration over all size-s circuits.

equations.label: collapsed_transfer
equations.valid_when: Requires the target-preserving transfer from MCSP threshold s(m) to E lower bounds while kappa remains constant and enumeration time stays E-compatible.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If a proposed source proves high MCSP by listing, simulating, or separately refuting all circuits of size 2^{epsilon m}, then it violates the 2^{O(m)} verifier budget for every constant epsilon>0.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Route falsifier for brute-force diagonal source constructions; it preserves the existing carrier bridge but quarantines one tempting source-soundness mechanism.
candidate_lemmas.statement: In the circuit-by-circuit diagonal MCSP certificate source model, E-compatible verification cannot certify a constant MCSP no-side threshold. If the verifier proves C(T)>s by explicitly excluding all m-input circuits of size s and must run in 2^{O(m)}, then s log s=O(m). Hence s=O(m/log m), and the carrier transfer exponent collapses to zero.

assumptions: The verifier is constructive in time poly(N)=2^{O(m)}.
Usefulness means every accepted T avoids SIZE(2^{epsilon m}).
definitions: Accepted range R_m={T_c: c accepted by V_m}.
Natural largeness at truth-table length N=2^m means density at least 1/poly(N)=2^{-O(m)}.
Sparse source means |R_m|<=2^{a m} for a fixed constant a.

equations.label: sparse_density
equations.valid_when: Valid when certificates have length at most a m and each certificate emits at most one truth table at the given source length.

equations.label: natural_gap
equations.valid_when: Applies in the truth-table universe of size 2^{2^m} where natural largeness is measured as inverse polynomial in N=2^m.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If a repair accepts 2^{2^m-O(m)} tables while remaining constructive and useful against SIZE(2^{epsilon m}), it enters the natural-proofs obstruction.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Barrier placement lemma: the sparse certificate route is outside natural largeness, while dense repairs become a natural-proof falsifier.
candidate_lemmas.statement: A certificate source with at most 2^{a m} accepted truth tables per length is not large in the Razborov-Rudich sense, since its density is at most 2^{a m-2^m}. Sparsity avoids the natural-proofs largeness condition, but it also removes counting as an existence proof.

assumptions: Circuit complexity of a truth table is the minimum circuit size of its indexed Boolean function.
MCSP soundness is semantic, not proof-system-relative.
definitions: Bit-access leakage means a circuit family A_{m,c}(x) computes the x-th emitted bit of V_m(c).
No-side threshold is C(T_c)>2^{epsilon m}.
The certificate c may be hardwired when judging nonuniform circuit complexity of T_c.

equations.label: leakage_contradiction
equations.valid_when: Valid when A_{m,c} computes every indexed output bit of the emitted truth table and c is allowed as nonuniform hardwired information.

candidate_lemmas.statement: Any accepted table T_c whose bit function x -> T_c[x] has nonuniform circuits of size r(m)<2^{epsilon m} is invalid as an MCSP no-side carrier at threshold 2^{epsilon m}. Sequential generation alone is harmless only if it does not yield such random access.

gedanken_experiment_design.need_decision: Use now as a falsifier probe for source-soundness proposals.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The bridge theorem is already valid; the live uncertainty is whether a concrete MCSP no-side source can prove soundness without secretly spending super-E time or leaking nonuniform random access.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: A padded diagonal MCSP certificate family: for each m, a certificate names a candidate truth table stream, and the verifier tries to certify that every circuit of size s=2^{beta m} disagrees with it somewhere.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A formal classification that the proposed verifier is genuinely enumerative or black-box over low circuits; without that certificate, the experiment is only a falsifier for brute-force diagonal repairs, not for compressed non-natural sources.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: The threshold exponent beta in s=2^{beta m}.
